title: Province calls inquest called into Russell Spence's death
article: An inquest has been called into the death of Russell Andrew Spence, 31, of Winnipeg, on Oct. 12, 2016, by Dr. John K. Younes, Manitoba's Acting Chief Medical Examiner.

Spence was arrested by Winnipeg police and taken to the Remand Centre. He was subdued by guards and police when a search led to a physical struggle. Four minutes after the struggle began, he suddenly became unresponsive. Resuscitation efforts at the scene and at Health Sciences Centre were unsuccessful.
The inquest will examine the circumstances of the death and try to determine whether procedures can be introduced to prevent similar deaths from occurring in the future.
A date for the inquest has yet to be set.
